error[ZBX-E0554]: the token service is on a host the password may not be sent to
  while  pushing an image
  cause  registry.test named the token service evil.test, which is not
         registry.test, nor a service it is known to use; the password was not
         sent
  host   registry.test
  realm  evil.test
  fix    push to a registry whose token service is on its own host; zbx sends a password only there
  more   zbx explain E0554
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0554.html
